newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on yen's rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on yen's rebound.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday, as the yen's late rebound against the dollar stimulated profit taking, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.2 yen to 5.2 yen per kg lower. Benchmark January was down 4.1 yen at 121.5 yen.
"After the recent upward trend, profit taking dominated the market," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
Concern over Asian currency problems also dampened sentiment, they said.
"Benchmark January may hover around 120 yen for a while in an attempt to consolidate," the analyst said.
